title: DocumentInstance
description: The `--instance` payload for `model eval` / `model compute` / `rule eval`: a filled document INSTANCE (the data to evaluate), NOT the model. This is A12's own canonical Document JSON — the shape the A12 kernel's document serializer reads and writes — so a document produced by an A12 application, or by `model seed`, is accepted verbatim. There is NO wrapper key: a ROOT GROUP name is a top-level key. The tree mirrors the model — a non-repeating group = a nested object keyed by child name; a repeating group = an ARRAY of row objects whose INDEX is the repetition (an unfilled row is `{}`); a present-but-empty group = `{}`; an omitted group or field = a MISSING key. A field is its value: native JSON for NUMBER and BOOLEAN/CONFIRM (`"Grams": 250`, `"Express": true`), a model-format string for the date family (DATE `"2026-01-01"`, DATE_TIME `"2026-01-01T09:30:00"`, TIME `"09:30:00"`), the S-value for an ENUMERATION, and `null` for a field that is PRESENT but carries no value (distinct from a missing key). A quoted number or boolean is accepted too and normalized exactly as A12 normalizes it (`"1e5"` and `1e5` both store `100000`); a value that cannot be converted to the declared kind is kept verbatim and reported by the formal check, never dropped. A root-level `id` is the document's identity, not a model field, and takes no part in evaluation. JSON comments (`//` and `/* */`) are accepted, because A12's own mappers accept them; a trailing comma is not, because A12's do not. Discover the model's structure with `model describe`.

id.description: the document's own identity — A12's serializer special case, not a model field; ignored by evaluation
